Ratt's "Wanted Man" reached #87 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Wanted Man" is the first track on American heavy metal band Ratt's album Out of the Cellar.

The song peaked at #87 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 3 weeks on the chart.

Wanted Man was released in 1984.

It was also featured on the soundtrack for the 1985 film Weird Science.

Background
The song was written in an abandoned building guitarist Warren DeMartini and former bassist Joey Cristofanilli were squatting in on Sunset Strip in Los Angeles.
